subject: Acquisition pathing: NDA, PO vs card, and security gates
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Tina Morales <tina@clearwave.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2024-09-12T14:12:00-07:00
Subject: Acquisition pathing: NDA, PO vs card, and security gates

Hi Tina — great conversation earlier today. Quick recap and suggested next steps for the procurement path so your procurement/legal teams can plan: 

1) Commercial route options (your preference):
   - Credit card (self-serve) — fastest for POC, limited contract.
   - Purchase order (PO) + standard Redwood SOW/Order Form — typical for orgs that need purchase control.
   - Cloud marketplace (AWS/GCP) — interested? clears some billing approvals but can add time for listing.

2) Security/compliance gating we heard from your team:SOC 2 Type II summary, DPA language, and a short security questionnaire.

3) Recommended immediate actions:
   - I can share our SOC 2 summary and standard DPA redline (attached).
   - If you want the PO route, confirm approximate PO lead time and the person who signs (we’ll prep Order Form).
   - If marketplace is of interest, that typically adds 3–5 weeks for procurement approvals but reduces internal billing paperwork long-term.

Attachments included: SOC2-Summary-2024.pdf, DPA-redline-ClearWave.docx, NDA-Redwood-template.pdf (we can send an executed NDA if you prefer).

Proposed next steps:
- Youloop in LegalOps (cc’d) to confirm DPA/PO policy and timeline.
- We schedule a 30-min follow-up with our contracts manager (Marissa) to align on Order Form terms.

Suggested meeting window: Mon/Tue next week (I’m PST) — what works for you?

Thanks,
Sergio
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: SOC2-Summary-2024.pdf (pdf)]
[Attachment: DPA-redline-ClearWave.docx (docx)]
From: Tina Morales <tina@clearwave.ai>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: LegalOps <legalops@clearwave.ai>, Kevin Lu <kevin@clearwave.ai>
Date: 2024-09-12T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Acquisition pathing: NDA, PO vs card, and security gates

Thanks, Sergio — helpful summary. A few clarifications from our side: 

- We will likely prefer PO + Order Form for anything production-facing. Card for an immediate POC could work if there’s a short-term threshold.
- Marketplace is interesting to our procurement team but they asked whether Redwood’s listing would include a consolidated invoice — that’s a plus.
- Security asks: LegalOps wants SOC 2 Type II report (not just summary) or a SOC 2 letter. They also want our standard DPA language run against Redwood’s DPA (we’ll send a redline).

I’ve copied LegalOps and Kevin (procurement lead) — LegalOps, can you confirm whether a SOC 2 summary suffices for procurement or if we need the full report? Also flag any DPA clauses that would be deal blockers.

Happy to meet next week; Tue AM PT works for Kevin and me.

—Tina
Head of Product Operations
ClearWave Health
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2024-09-12T16:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Acquisition pathing: NDA, PO vs card, and security gates

Sergio — good recap. Quick internal notes: 

- SOC 2: we can provide the SOC 2 Type II report under NDA (standard process). If LegalOps prefers, we can arrange a controlled upload to their portal.
- DPA: I attached the standard redwood DPA (Sergio already included a redline but we should ensure LegalOps gets our latest DPA). If they return heavy redlines, escalate to Legal.
- Marketplace: If they opt for marketplace, start with a provisional PO path in parallel — that keeps momentum while listing is confirmed.

I’ll join the Tue slot and run Order Form options (term lengths, payment terms, SSO & data residency clauses). Ben — FYI in case procurement policy/discounts need alignment.

-Marissa
Head of Commercial Contracts
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood-Standard-DPA-2024.pdf (pdf)]
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Tina Morales <tina@clearwave.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, LegalOps <legalops@clearwave.ai>
Date: 2024-09-12T18:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Acquisition pathing: NDA, PO vs card, and security gates

Tina / LegalOps — thanks for the quick notes. Here is a practical path I propose to keep momentum: 

1) Immediate POC (if desired): Card payment or short-term PO (<30 days). We’ll provision environment and provide an access checklist.
2) Parallel security exchange: Redwood will: 
   - Share SOC 2 Type II report via secure link (requires NDA) — I’ve attached the summary and can send the report after NDA.
   - Send our base DPA (attached) — LegalOps can redline.
3) Procurement route: If your procurement confirms PO lead time >2 weeks, we’ll draft an Order Form and hold preferred pricing for 30 days pending PO issuance. If marketplace is selected later, we’ll coordinate to switch billing with minimal interruption.

Action items before Tue meeting (please):
- LegalOps: indicate whether we should send SOC2 report to a secure SFTP or via DocuSign portal.
- Kevin: confirm expected PO timing and the approver name/email.
- Tina: confirm Tue 10:00 AM PT and I’ll send a calendar invite with Marissa included.

DocuSign link for our standard NDA: https://www.docusign.com/link/abc123 (or I can attach a PDF)
HubSpot record for this deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/67890

Thanks — sending calendar invite now.

—Sergio
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: NDA-Redwood-template.pdf (pdf)]
From: Kevin Lu <kevin@clearwave.ai>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>, Tina Morales <tina@clearwave.ai>
Cc: LegalOps <legalops@clearwave.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2024-09-13T09:23:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Acquisition pathing: NDA, PO vs card, and security gates

Sergio — confirmed for Tue 10:00 AM PT. Quick answers: 

- PO timing: typically 2–3 weeks once approver signs, but budget release may add ~1 week. Approver: Emily Park (finance@clearwave.ai).
- SOC 2: LegalOps prefers full SOC 2 Type II report uploaded to our secure evidence portal; NDA is fine.
- Marketplace: procurement likes the idea but wants to see listing cadence; not a blocker for today.

I’ll ask LegalOps to watch for the DocuSign NDA link and we’ll route the SOC 2 upload after NDA execution. See you Tue.

-Kevin
Procurement Lead
ClearWave Health
